payload.summary: Plan moving the developer-gated Developer Hub and Care Plan tools out of the mockups folder
payload.detail: src/app/mockups/development (11 pages) and src/app/mockups/care-plan (21 pages) are live behind DeveloperAreaGate but sit under a folder named mockups, which invites deletion by clean-up. check:mockups already refuses deletions there without an owner decision recorded in mockups/README.md. Next action: in a later architecture phase, move them to /admin/developer-hub and /admin/care-plan with redirects, keeping DEVELOPER_GATED_PATH_PREFIXES and the retirement gate in step.
payload.source: Review of five Antigravity reports against main, 2026-10-12
